company_info.description: Shinpo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells smokeless roasters in Japan and internationally. The company offers round type, square type, and hot plate smokeless roaster; upper, upper-drawer slim, and upper-drawer hood; yakitori maker; tabletop, built-in, and built-in gas stove unit; cooking cart; and energy-saving air conditioning systems. It also provides accessories, such as super net/flat net, shinpotong, grill cleaning machines, roasters, grills, and ceramic charcoal parts. In addition, the company provides interior construction; system design and installation of smokeless roaster; maintenance; duct cleaning services. Shinpo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. As of June 15, 2026, Shinpo Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Yamatake Sogyo Y.K..
